name: Battle Master
desc: Battle Master: a fighter subclass. Hand-written summary, not the book text.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.desc: Learn three maneuvers and gain four superiority dice (d8). Dice come back on a short or long rest.

features.name: Student of War
features.desc: Gain proficiency with one set of artisan's tools.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.desc: Study a creature for 1 minute to learn how it compares to you in key traits.

features.name: Relentless
features.desc: Regain one die if you roll initiative with none left.
